dedupeResult: The complete open PR patch was searched for each official name, canonical domain and public route. No prior UKF/Pilot demo-inbox, V Recordings multi-imprint demo-box or Future House Music Trackstack/Discord submission-agent record was found. Each opportunity is stored once; store support, privacy contacts, newsletters, Discord community links and duplicate route representations are consolidated or excluded.
emailVerificationLevel: No public mailbox was treated as a music-submission route. orders@ukf.com is first-party store support, dpo@aei.co.uk is UKF's official privacy contact, support@databeats.com is the current V Recordings platform/privacy support contact, and info@futurehousemusic.net is published in Future House Music's official privacy policy. Each is syntactically valid and first-party published for its stated non-demo purpose. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: All three canonical opportunities originate from official public first-party pages. UKF links to a fully inspectable Jotform using a private SoundCloud link and containing a honeypot plus optional newsletter consent. V Recordings exposes an embedded demo box for four imprints but not its inner fields and presents a Databeats account/session boundary. Future House Music links to a Trackstack inbox accepting up to five MP3/WAV tracks and to a Discord demo-drop community, creating external account, availability, terms and possible feature/pricing boundaries. No field, account, invite, upload, link, consent, CAPTCHA, honeypot, payment or submit action was exercised.
safety: No email was sent, no form field was filled, no account or Discord invite was used, no private music link was shared, no audio or press file was uploaded, no consent or terms were accepted, no CAPTCHA, honeypot or hidden anti-spam control was tested, no payment was used and no submission, authentication or platform restriction was bypassed.
